description: Pinned baseline for generate-opencode-config.js --validate latency. Eliminates Gap D false positives by measuring baseline AND comparison in the SAME execution context (the test run). Methodology: 5 runs of 'node generate-opencode-config.js --validate', median in milliseconds. Threshold: 10% relative regression from pinned baseline. Baseline pinned from Cycle #3 benchmark fixture.
methodology: 5 runs of 'node scripts/lib/generate-opencode-config.js --validate', wall-time measured via Stopwatch, median + IQR reported. Both baseline and comparison execute in test-process context — no cross-context mismatch.
